capacity_usable_kwh.notes: The Car Guide (Canada 2026): this trim has the 63 kWh pack; Nissan Canada specs page: 63 kWh and 87 kWh usable.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Nissan Canada specs: 66 kWh pack (usable 63). The existing OpenEV gross value of 63 kWh equals the usable figure.

supercharger_access.notes: Nissan Ariya Supercharger access from 2024-12-10 via a Nissan CCS-to-NACS adapter ($235 US, per Electrek and Nissan). Canada: adapter at $309.99 (The Car Guide names the 2025 Ariya; 2026 had "no technological updates" so assumed the same). The refreshed 2027 Canadian car is reported to get a native NACS port; not applicable here.

charge_port.notes: 2023 US press kit: CCS port. The Canadian 2026 Ariya had "no cosmetic revisions or technological updates" (The Car Guide, src-guideauto-ariya-2026-canada), and Nissan reports a native NACS port only for the refreshed 2027 Ariya (autoevolution, 2027 Canada article), so the 2026 car keeps CCS1 and uses the Nissan adapter for Superchargers (via_adapter). The Nissan Canada specs page lists "Quick charge port-NACS" plus a $317 adapter kit, which looks like the 2027 car.

wheels.notes: Nissan Canada Ariya specs page lists 19-inch alloy wheels with aero covers (and 20-inch alloy wheels, trim mapping not readable); 19-inch taken as standard, low confidence.
